newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds gather forces at 100.80 for push up.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds gather forces at 100.80 for push up.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE may slip back slightly on Friday but a reverse head and shoulder pattern provides a solid basis for a continued upward correction, technical analysts said.
The contract was well support around 100.80, they said.
"We do see some negatives on stochastics on the hourlies and that means it may come back a bit," said Geert-Jan Nikken at ABN-AMRO in Amersterdam. "We do expect 100.80 to hold."
The contract was quoted at 100.86 at 0640 GMT, down eight basis points from Thursday's settlement.
Support around 100.80 comes from Thursday's low at 100.79.

Nikken said the reverse head and shoulders pattern consisted of the March 20 low at 99.52 forming the left shoulder, the head at the lows of 99.05 and 99.08 on April 3 and 4, and the right shoulder at the April 14 low of 99.70.
The neckline was broken in price action April 15 and 16, giving a positive signal, he said.
Nikken said if support at 100.80 was broken the contract would likely slip back down to the 100.53 level, the low from April 16.
This would bring the contract back down through the neckline and restrain the upward move, he said.
On the upside, initial resistance would come in at Thursday's high of 101.14, Nikken said.
Beyond there, there was a strong cap in the 101.19 to 101.25 zone from March 14 and March 7 lows respectively. The contract slid lower from around here on March 17.
The head and shoulders pattern gives an ultimate objective of 102.05, he added.

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said the market failed on Thursday around 101.13, near the 50 percent retracement of the fall from 1997 highs. But he too said the overall picture was bullish.
"Further strength can be looked for over the coming days towards 101.50 and maybe as far as 102.00 in due course," he said in a research note.
"Against this background, setbacks continue to offer buying opportunities with stops placed under 100.53," he said.
June Euromark futures were quoted at 96.75, down 0.01 from Thursday.
